blocks.content: In coordinate system setting, the PMC on the host NC sets the function code, command data 1, and command data 2, then sends the ST signal to the servo unit, Upon receipt of the data, the servo unit returns the operation completion 1 signal to the NC.
Upon receipt of the operation completion 4 signal, the PMC on the host NC returns the FIN signal.
The start enabled state is that state in which the STL signal is off.
